subject.title: Garden Grove Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: Nonprofit Executive Director
Please join the teachers, nurses, and librarians of the Garden Grove Education Association in supporting our campaign for a stronger, more responsible Garden Grove Unified School District.

As a nonprofit director, county housing commissioner, and longtime community organizer, I have spent over a decade working to support Garden Grove Unified students and families. I’m committed to fighting for our public education by investing in safe, modern school facilities, supporting educators, expanding student resources, and ensuring taxpayer dollars are spent responsibly.

I’m the proud daughter of Vietnamese refugees and a product of public schools. As the first in my family to graduate from college, I know firsthand how public education changes lives. Public schools gave me the skills to propel my public service career and build a nonprofit that empowers youth and fights for immigrant families.

I will always advocate for students to have the resources they need to succeed. As Trustee, I will fight to expand:
Mental health and basic needs services,
Dual-immersion language programs,
Resources for students with special needs.
Our students, families, and school staff deserve leaders who will fight for strong public schools. That’s why I’m running to represent Trustee Area 4 on the GGUSD Board of Education.

text: Small Businessowner/Parent

As a father, business owner, and longtime community volunteer, I am committed to ensuring every Garden Grove Unified student receives an excellent education in a safe environment that prepares them for college, careers, military service, and life.

I have volunteered in the Garden Grove Unified School District for over 13 years, including seven years as Parent Association President at La Quinta High School. Working alongside parents, teachers, and administrators has given me firsthand experience with the opportunities and challenges facing our schools.

For more than 30 years, I have mentored young people through the Naval Sea Cadet Corps, where I served 10 years as a Lieutenant Junior Grade, as well as the Boy Scouts, Girl Scouts, TNTT, GDPT, and other youth organizations, helping instill leadership, discipline, and character.

As your Trustee, I will focus on academic excellence, safe schools, fiscal responsibility, and meaningful parental involvement. I will support career education, internships, mentorships, and workforce partnerships while supporting our teachers and neighborhood schools, ensuring every student has the opportunity to succeed.
I am proud to have the support of Orange County Supervisor Janet Nguyen and Fountain Valley Mayor Ted Bui, and I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: Attorney/Educational Coach

I grew up in GGUSD. I went to Monroe Elementary, Ethan Allen Elementary, Fitz Intermediate, and Los Amigos high school. I’m a lawyer and Certified Public Accountant by profession. I am grateful to the district that helped me become who I am today.

For over eight years, as a parent, I have served our school community as Allen’s PTO Secretary and Treasurer and now as Fitz's PTO President. Being on campus regularly gives me firsthand perspective on how to better serve students and parents.
Alongside my wife, a GGUSD teacher, I have seen what makes our schools work: teachers who give everything, staff who hold it together, and families who show up for their children.
Professionally, I bring legal and financial expertise and a commitment to accountability and transparency to every decision.

I am running because GGUSD gave me everything, and now it’s my turn to give back. Our students deserve a board member who has walked these halls, sat in these classrooms, and never stopped showing up.
I am supported by three current board members, Bob Harden, Teri Rocco and Lan Nguyen. I ask for your vote — not just to represent our schools, but to serve the community that raised me.
